{"status":0,"stderr":"","signal":null,"stdout":"OVERVIEW: Install packages by name, name=version, or a .deb file's path, with
what they need.

USAGE: irisin-cli install [--json] [--verbose] [--yes] [--dry-run] [--allow-system-removal] <packages> ...

ARGUMENTS:
  <packages>              Package identifiers, identifier=version, or paths to
                          .deb files.

OPTIONS:
  --json                  Print one JSON object per line instead of text.
  -v, --verbose           Print what the catalogue and the helper say along the
                          way.
  -y, --yes               Go ahead without asking.
  --dry-run               Run the transaction as a dry run: check everything,
                          change nothing.
  --allow-system-removal  Allow removing a package the system requires
                          (Irisin's Power Operations).
  --version               Show the version.
  -h, --help              Show help information.

"}
